title: Without Delete, Part Status in the part dialog is disabled
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-STATUS) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-STATUS-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-ST-A1) is active at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-ST-I1) is inactive at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Look at Part Status and the pill in the title row.
  3. Try to pick Inactive.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click the Inactive tab, search {Part-B} and click its row.
  6. Look at Part Status and the pill in the title row.
  7. Try to pick Active.
  8. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Part Status shows Active selected and both options disabled; the title row shows the green "Active" pill.
  • Step 3: Inactive cannot be picked; Active stays selected.
  • Step 6: Part Status shows Inactive selected and both options disabled; the title row shows the grey "Inactive" pill.
  • Step 7: Active cannot be picked.
  • Step 8: {Part-B} is still on the Inactive tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R6, S13-R20, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog) and 3.6 (Opening the inactive part), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R6: “That user sees the Part Status choice in the part dialog disabled (S13-R20).”
  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
